data.summary:
**When:** [Your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), after one of your **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** units makes a **[Malefic Surge](vsdata:ability/chaos-knights.infernal-lance.malefic-surge)**.

**Target:** That same **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit.

**Effect:** Pick an objective marker you control that the unit is in range of. It stays under your control until a phase ends with your [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it lower than your opponent's.
